verdict.rationale: Firstbase sells registered-agent service online with published pricing ($299 per state/year), covers all 50 states, and offers an online flow to change your registered agent. Nothing in the evidence shows the founder receives the exact agent name and street address for a filing, let alone the same day. missing for 10: documented delivery of the agent name and street address for formation/change filings, a same-day turnaround commitment, independent or hands-on corroboration.
